claims.title: Four-transvection simultaneous straightening of a split pair, coset-preserving linear shears, and head-projection unimodularity
claims.hypotheses: Commutative ring R with identity 1; rank m ∈ ℕ and orthogonal vectors a, b ∈ R^m (b · a = 0) for rank-one transvections T_{a,b} = I_m + a b^T; stable-range bound s ∈ ℕ (every unimodular tuple in R^{d+1} for d ≥ s shortens to a unimodular tuple in R^d), rank parameter n ∈ ℕ with s ≤ n, and split pair v, f ∈ R^{n+1} satisfying f · v = 1; finitely supported sequence module M_∞ = ⨁_{k≥0} R e_k with low coordinate span L_n = {x ∈ M_∞ : ∀ k ≥ n, x_k = 0}, affine cosets A_{n,j} = {x ∈ M_∞ : x − e_j ∈ L_n}, linear form h ∈ Hom_R(M_∞, R), and shear direction t ∈ L_n satisfying h(t) = 0; and arbitrary R-module M, linear form φ ∈ Hom_R(M, R), vector u ∈ M with φ(u) = 1, and list l = [x_0, …, x_{q−1}] (q ∈ ℕ) in M.
claims.statement: For a, b ∈ R^m with b · a = 0, T_{a,b} = I_m + a b^T ∈ GL_m(R) has inverse I_m − a b^T and acts on all x, r ∈ R^m by T_{a,b} x = x + (b · x) a and r T_{a,b}^{−1} = r − (r · a) b, and when R has stable range at most s ≤ n and f · v = 1 on R^{n+1}, a product g = g_4 g_3 g_2 g_1 ∈ GL_{n+1}(R) of four rank-one transvections satisfies g v = e_n and f g^{−1} = e_n; on M_∞, ψ(x) = x + h(x) t (t ∈ L_n, h(t) = 0) is an R-linear automorphism with inverse x − h(x) t preserving L_n and every A_{n,j}; and on any R-module M with φ(u) = 1 and P(x) = x − φ(x) u, P(u) = 0 and [u] ++ l ∈ 𝒰(M) holds if and only if P(l) ∈ 𝒰(M).
definitions: rank-one transvection T_{a,b} = I_m + a b^T ∈ GL_m(R) for b · a = 0 with inverse T_{a,b}^{−1} = I_m − a b^T
low coordinate submodule L_n = {x ∈ M_∞ : ∀ k ≥ n, x_k = 0}, affine cosets A_{n,j} = e_j + L_n, and finitely supported shear ψ(x) = x + h(x) t
idempotent head projection P(x) = x − φ(x) u for φ(u) = 1 and lifted dual functionals F_0 = φ − ∑_{k=0}^{q−1} φ(x_k)(H_k ∘ P), F_{i+1} = H_i ∘ P

claims.correspondence: Three rank-one transvections carry v to e_n via stable-range row shortening, and left-multiplying by T_{e_n, f′ − e_n} fixes e_n while straightening f′ = f g_0^{−1} to e_n; low-support shears x + h(x) t with h(t) = 0 preserve L_n and A_{n,j}; and P = id_M − φ(·) u restricts tail duals in the forward direction and lifts duals via F_0 = φ − ∑_k φ(x_k)(H_k ∘ P) in the converse.
claims.review: Checked orthogonality conditions e_n · a = 0, ((1 − w_n)c′) · e_n = 0, e_n · (e_n − u) = 0, and (f′ − e_n) · e_n = 0 across all four transvections, contragredient dot-product invariance, support bound < n for h(x) t, and all four Kronecker-delta cases on [u] ++ l.

claims.title: Prefix-concatenation boundary Leibniz rule, prepending cone homotopy, and equivariant transport of link exactness
claims.hypotheses: Arbitrary alphabets V and W with free abelian list chain groups ℤ[List(V)] on basis generators ⟨l⟩, augmented alternating face-deletion boundary ∂ (∂⟨[]⟩ = 0, ∂⟨[x]⟩ = ⟨[]⟩), length-p chain subgroups C_p(F) for F ⊆ List(V), prefix links link_X(F, τ), and injective map e : V → W; commutative ring R with identity, first-m-coordinate embedding emb_m : R^m ↪ M_∞ onto L_m, R-module M with subset X ⊆ M and X-preserving R-linear automorphism ψ : M ≅_R M, and (for the rank-step reduction) stable range at most s ∈ ℕ with s ≤ n, j ≥ n + 1, nonempty τ ∈ 𝒰(M_∞), and exactness of link_{L_n ∪ A_{n,k}}(𝒰(M_∞), σ) at length q for every k ≥ n, σ ∈ 𝒰(M_∞), and q ∈ ℕ satisfying q + s + |σ| ≤ n + 1.
claims.statement: For every τ ∈ List(V), x ∈ V, and c ∈ ℤ[List(V)], ∂(τ ++ c) = ((∂⟨τ⟩) ++ c) + (−1)^{|τ|}(τ ++ ∂c), ∂(κ_x(c)) = c − κ_x(∂c) for κ_x(⟨l⟩) = ⟨[x] ++ l⟩, and ∂(∂c) = 0; every injection e : V → W induces C_p(F) ≅ C_p(e_*(F)) commuting with ∂ so exactness of e_*(F) at length p is equivalent to exactness of F at length p, identifying emb_{m*}(𝒰_m) = link_{L_m}(𝒰(M_∞), []) to deduce exactness of 𝒰_m from link_{L_m}(𝒰(M_∞), []); and every X-preserving ψ : M ≅_R M pulls exactness of link_X(𝒰(M), ψ_*(τ)) at length p back to link_X(𝒰(M), τ), establishing nonempty-prefix link exactness on L_{n+1} ∪ A_{n+1,j} for p + s + |τ| ≤ n + 2 from the rank-n affine-link hypothesis.
definitions: prefix-concatenation operator τ ++ c and single-letter prepending cone operator κ_x(⟨l⟩) = ⟨[x] ++ l⟩ on ℤ[List(V)]
pushforward list family e_*(F) = {e_*(l) : l ∈ F} along an injection e : V → W and coordinate-subspace embedding emb_m : R^m ↪ M_∞
equivariant prefix-link identity (ψ^{−1})_*(link_X(𝒰(M), ψ_*(τ))) = link_X(𝒰(M), τ) for X-preserving ψ ∈ Aut_R(M)

claims.title: Finite-support fiber decomposition of vertical and horizontal double-complex slices and chain isomorphism to the permutation representation complex
claims.hypotheses: Alphabets V and W, relation 𝒟 ⊆ List(V) × List(W), bidegree (a, b) ∈ ℕ², double-complex chain group D_{a,b}(𝒟) with horizontal and vertical differentials ∂_h and ∂_v, column fibers Col_𝒟(l) = {w : (l, w) ∈ 𝒟} (assumed exact at length b whenever |l| = a and Col_𝒟(l) ≠ ∅ for vertical exactness), and row fibers Row_𝒟(w) = {l : (l, w) ∈ 𝒟} (assumed exact at length a whenever |w| = b and Row_𝒟(w) ≠ ∅ for horizontal exactness); commutative ring R with identity, rank n ∈ ℕ, untyped split-sequence set 𝒮_n ⊆ List(R^n × R^n) (assumed exact at length 0 for d_0 surjectivity and at length p + 1 for ker(d_p) = im(d_{p+1})), typed p-simplex sets 𝒮_{n,p} = {l ∈ 𝒮_n : |l| = p} with inclusions η_p, linear extensions Φ_p : ℤ[𝒮_{n,p}] → ℤ[List(R^n × R^n)], and alternating face maps d_p : ℤ[𝒮_{n,p+1}] → ℤ[𝒮_{n,p}].
claims.statement: Every x ∈ D_{a,b}(𝒟) decomposes over finite support projections T_1 ⊂ List(V) and T_2 ⊂ List(W) as x = ∑_{l∈T_1} ι_l(g_l) = ∑_{w∈T_2} j_w(p_w(x)) with ∂_v(ι_l(g_l)) = ι_l(∂_W g_l) and ∂_h(j_w(p_w(x))) = j_w(∂_V p_w(x)), so exactness of every nonempty Col_𝒟(l) (|l| = a) at length b implies every ∂_v-cycle in D_{a,b}(𝒟) bounds vertically in D_{a,b+1}(𝒟), and exactness of every nonempty Row_𝒟(w) (|w| = b) at length a implies every ∂_h-cycle in D_{a,b}(𝒟) bounds horizontally in D_{a+1,b}(𝒟); furthermore, Φ_p is injective with image C_p(𝒮_n) and Φ_p(d_p(c)) = ∂(Φ_{p+1}(c)), giving d_p ∘ d_{p+1} = 0 and transferring exactness of 𝒮_n at length 0 to surjectivity of d_0 and exactness at length p + 1 to ker(d_p) = im(d_{p+1}).
definitions: column-slice currying x = ∑_{l∈T_1} ι_l(g_l) (g_l(w) = x(l, w), ι_l(⟨w⟩) = ⟨(l, w)⟩) and row-slice currying x = ∑_{w∈T_2} j_w(p_w(x)) (p_w(x)(l) = x(l, w), j_w(⟨l⟩) = ⟨(l, w)⟩)
typed p-simplex set 𝒮_{n,p} = {l ∈ 𝒮_n : |l| = p} with linear inclusion Φ_p : ℤ[𝒮_{n,p}] → ℤ[List(R^n × R^n)] onto C_p(𝒮_n)
typed representation differential d_p(⟨σ⟩) = ∑_{i=0}^p (−1)^i ⟨∂_i(σ)⟩ intertwined with ∂ via Φ_p ∘ d_p = ∂ ∘ Φ_{p+1}
